cases.note: diagram mismatch only (both accept): `listsprites` is ListSpriteDiagramFactory (SPRITES) but ListSpriteDiagram is built as DiagramType.HELP, which the oracle reports

FA. The jar's preprocessor leaves only `@startuml` (no end line; BlockUml.getData), so every factory fails ("Empty description"; PSystemWelcomeFactory needs exactly two lines). The interpreter runs embedded-welcome's `empty` context over the body plus the end line; with no end line that is zero lines, which no model can refuse (tools/interp/engine.py `_attempt`). Engine change queued: an empty body without an end line must not reach `empty`. Lark rejects the block, as the jar does.
